Eugene V. KLEIN, d/b/a Del Rayo Racing Stable, Plaintiff-Appellant, 
V. 
UNIVERSAL JET SALES, INC., and PepsiCo, Inc., Defendant-Appellees. 
Nos. 87-1086(L), 87-1094 and 87-1095. 
I 
Argued March 10, 1988. 
I 
Decided April 25, 1988. 
Seller appealed from order of the United States District Court for the District of Virginia, Richard L. 
Williams, J., which found breach of contract for sale of aircraft and order of specific performance. The 
Court of Appeals, Ervin, Circuit Judge, held that: (1) evidence sustained finding that contract had been 
formed, and (2) remedy of specific performance was not warranted. 
Affirmed in part, reversed and remanded in part. 
Opinion 
ERVIN, Circuit Judge: 
This case turns on whether a contract was formed between Universal Jet Sales, Inc. ("UJS") and PepsiCo, 
Inc., ("PepsiCo") for the sale of a Gulfstream G-11 corporate jet to UJS for resale to one Eugene V. Klein. 
If a contract was formed, the question remains whether the district court acted within his discretion by 
ordering specific performance of the contract. We believe the district court properly found that a contract 
was formed; however, we conclude that the remedy of specific performance is inappropriate. Accordingly, 
we affirm in part, reverse and remand in part.
